decisions.reason: Expanding the permitted curation actions for existing questions does not change the layered answer structure; the answer-layer changes stated separately in message 18 are already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.

The source Requirement's addition and rewording actions concern individual-question curation and do not alter the candidate's category and chapter structure recommendations, which are separately captured from message 18.
Reviewing and curating the existing question set does not change the independently defined pre-interview preparation chapter.
The source change applies to curation of existing questions and does not alter the new candidate-questions chapter or its question-count policy.
The existing-question curation change does not alter the subject, format, or question-count policy of the new first-time-leader chapter.
The source modification concerns review of the existing question set and leaves the separate remote and hybrid leadership chapter unchanged.
The expanded curation actions for existing questions do not affect the AI interview-preparation chapter.
The editorial approval gate is already separately and completely established by message 18; the source curation change does not require any additional candidate-state update.
Adding and rewording existing questions does not necessarily change the established international-perspective integration rules.
The source Event changes question-set curation rather than the manuscript editing workflow; unrelated access statements in the same long message are not cross-Requirement consequences of this Event.
The existing-question curation change does not modify the companion-resource deliverable or its delivery format.
The question-curation expansion does not change the existing 110,000-word ceiling; message 18 only reiterates that independent constraint.
